title: Two Races, Reproduced Before and After the Fix
subtitle: The same boot repeated many times under plain TCG on a heavily loaded host

rows.label: Tick race, before
rows.detail: The timer ticks self-test read ticks and the interrupt count as two loads with interrupts on. Load average 299.31 at the start

rows.label: Tick race, after
rows.detail: Both values read in one snapshot with interrupts off

rows.label: Exit race, before
rows.detail: crash=pagefault and crash=panic, 20 boots each, expected exit code 3. Load average 287.04 at the start

rows.label: Exit race, after
rows.detail: The hart parks in wfi after writing the failure code to the sifive,test0 device

caption: Neither race showed up reliably in a single boot, which is why each fix is backed by a repeated-boot count rather than one passing run.
source: repeated boots on QEMU, 30 for the tick race and 40 for the exit race
